title: Statistics
intro: Cases started in the selected period, what happened to them and how that compares with the period before.
empty: No cases were started in this period.
truncated: The period holds more cases than one view can count, so the numbers are incomplete. Choose a shorter period or fewer services.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.none: Nothing needs attention: no failed cases, no back-office queue and no large change for the worse.
attention.failed: Failed cases waiting for a fix

kpi.title: Key indicators
kpi.subtitle: Compared with the previous period of the same length. Choose an indicator to see it per day.

trend.subtitle: Per day, by the day the case started

mix.title: Services
mix.subtitle: Cases started, by status now. Choose a service to focus on it.

flow.title: Case flow
flow.subtitle: From start, through the back office or straight through, to where each case stands now. Band width is the number of cases.
flow.returned: Cases returned to the applicant for correction at least once: {{count}}

services.title: Service comparison
services.subtitle: Choose a service to focus the whole page on it.

backOffice.title: Back office
backOffice.subtitle: The team as a whole: tasks for civil servants in the selected cases. Task time runs from the task being created to it being done, so it includes time in the queue.
